PREFIX  wde:  <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  ?var1 ?var2 ?var3 ?var4 ?var5 ?var6
WHERE
  { { ?var1  wdt:P31  wde:Q70208 }
    { ?var1  wdt:P771  ?var2 }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?var1  rdfs:label  ?var3
        FILTER ( lang(?var3) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?var1  rdfs:label  ?var4
        FILTER ( lang(?var4) = "de" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?var1  rdfs:label  ?var5
        FILTER ( lang(?var5) = "fr" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?var1  rdfs:label  ?var6
        FILTER ( lang(?var6) = "it" )
      }
    FILTER ( ?var2 = "3945" )
  }
